title: Swin-Unet: Unet-like Pure Transformer for Medical Image Segmentation
layout_note: Symmetric U on a tall canvas: the encoder column descends on the left, a two-block bottleneck sits centred at the bottom, and the decoder column climbs on the right; the input and output images cap the two columns at the top, and three horizontal skip arrows cross the gap between them.
grouping: Encoder, bottleneck and decoder each sit in a thin dashed grey rounded container, named in plain text just outside a lower corner (Encoder, Decoder) or centred below (Bottleneck). Within the columns every resolution stage is a square-cornered pale-green band holding its blocks; the bands at the deepest scale (the last Patch Merging and the bottleneck) are saturated cyan, and the final Patch Expanding is bright yellow. Patch Partition and Linear Projection stand outside the containers as white rounded boxes.
shapes_depth: Flat rounded rectangles with thin black outlines and no shadows, filled with their band's colour or white; Swin Transformer Blocks are drawn about twice as tall as the Patch Merging and Patch Expanding boxes. No tensors are drawn: thick black orthogonal arrows carry the data and the sizes are text, and skip connections are long thin horizontal arrows. The input CT slice and the colour-coded segmentation output are square thumbnails above the two columns.
proposed_highlight: No element is singled out as new: the whole architecture is the proposal, built from one block type, and the box names carry the content (Swin Transformer Block x2, Patch Merging, Patch Expanding). Colour marks position rather than novelty: cyan for the deepest level, yellow for the last upsampling box, pale green for every other stage.
lesson: Tensor sizes sit in the outer margins level with each stage, mirrored left and right, and the skip scale (1/4, 1/8, 1/16) sits on the skip arrows, so the two columns carry no annotation at all.
notes: year = arXiv preprint year (2105.05537); venue ECCV Workshops recorded from Semantic Scholar (venue_source: semantic-scholar); refs.json gives 2022 from a citing paper's reference list, not verified here. Margin sizes are set in a serif italic math face (W/4 x H/4 x 48 ... W x H x Class) while box labels are sans. The whole figure is embedded in the PDF as one raster image, so photo_share is unknown (null) and the palette is measured over the raster, CT thumbnails included.

measured.source: computed: paperfig kb measure (non-white pixels of a <= 800 px thumbnail, white = min(R,G,B) >= 245, minus the embedded images recorded by `refs crop` (images_px; their share is photo_share, null without a record); chromatic (RGB spread > 20) and neutral pixels clustered separately by PIL median-cut + k-means (k=8 / 3); clusters within dE00 4 merged; kept if >= 0.02 of chromatic pixels / neutral ones if >= 0.03 of all non-white pixels; share = fraction of the non-photo non-white pixels)

core.what: a vertical U: the path descends the encoder column on the left, crosses a two-block bottleneck at the bottom and climbs the decoder column on the right, with three horizontal skip arrows joining stages of matching scale

relations.form: top-to-bottom down the encoder, left-to-right across the bottleneck, bottom-to-top up the decoder, from a CT slice at top left to its segmentation at top right
three straight horizontal arrows labelled 'Skip Connection 1/4, 1/8, 1/16' join each encoder stage to the decoder stage at the same height
each column is a stack of green-tinted stage boxes, each holding a merging (or expanding) step and a Swin Transformer Block x2, with tensor shapes typeset in the outer margins at each stage
input is a real abdominal CT slice and the output is the same slice with coloured organ masks

channels.colour: green = an encoder or decoder stage; blue = the bottleneck, but it also fills the encoder's last Patch Merging, so blue marks both 'bottleneck' and one encoder step; yellow fills only the final Patch Expanding (x4) with no stated meaning; organ colours in the output are class labels
channels.shape: rounded rectangles for every block; images at the two ends
channels.line: one solid arrow style for both the main path and the skips
channels.frame: dashed rounded frames = Encoder, Decoder and Bottleneck; tinted rectangles = one stage

quality.strengths: The U geometry with straight horizontal skips at matching heights makes the scale correspondence visible without labels; the mirror placement of Patch Merging and Patch Expanding shows the decoder as the encoder's inverse; real image in and real segmentation out.
quality.weaknesses: Colour has unclear meanings (blue spans the bottleneck and the last encoder merging, yellow highlights one layer unexplained); every block is the same size and text-filled, so nothing marks what is new; tensor shapes float in the margins away from the arrows they describe; the encoder-to-bottleneck and bottleneck-to-decoder links bend twice.

insights.structure: A vertical U: encoder column on the left and decoder column on the right, each in a dashed frame of green tinted stages, joined at the bottom by a dashed Bottleneck frame of two blue Swin blocks; three horizontal skip arrows labelled 1/4, 1/8, 1/16 connect matching stages.
insights.data: The input is a real abdominal CT slice at top-left and the output the same slice with colour organ masks at top-right; tensor shapes (W/4 x H/4 x C etc.) are typeset in the outer margins beside each stage.
insights.emphasis: Colour marks operation type rather than contribution: green stages for Swin blocks, blue for patch merging/bottleneck, a single yellow box for the final 4x Patch Expanding layer, the paper's new upsampling op.
insights.flow: Down the left column, along the bottom through the bottleneck, up the right column; skips run straight horizontally, so the figure reads as a U-turn from top-left to top-right.
insights.avoid: Shape annotations are placed outside both columns with no leader lines, and the colours (green/blue/yellow) have no key, so their meaning must be guessed.

arrangement.units: three dashed rounded frames (Encoder, Bottleneck, Decoder) labelled underneath, each holding tinted stage blocks
arrangement.inputs_as: real CT image above the encoder column; output segmentation above the decoder column
arrangement.shared: horizontal skip connections between encoder and decoder stages of equal scale
